biocontainers.name: bioconductor-idr2d
biocontainers.summary: Irreproducible discovery rate for genomic interactions data

biotools.summary: A tool to measure reproducibility between genomic experiments that produce two-dimensional peaks (interactions between peaks), such as ChIA-PET, HiChIP, and HiC. idr2d is an extension of the original idr package, which is intended for (one-dimensional) ChIP-seq peaks.
